post.description: Joins the OPEN aggregation of (organization, productId), or opens one with the first demand, under the aggregation’s row lock and the database clock read after it. The window is half-open, [openedAt, closesAt): a demand at or after closesAt never joins it — that same request ends the window (READY when it holds a demand and reaches its threshold; otherwise its snapshot’s policy: EXTEND moves it on and the demand joins it, REFER and CLOSE end it) and the demand joins the window that follows. A demand that would take the total of the window it joins past 2147483647 is 422 AGGREGATION_QUANTITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and writes nothing. productId is opaque and never checked against marketplace (Q-105, Q-120). DEMAND_SUBMITTED carries identifiers, the quantity and instants only — never the note. Closed by default (S-02). The buyer’s own organization only: a person holding a role PROCUREMENT_DEMAND_ROLES names (default PROCUREMENT_USER, ORGANIZATION_ADMIN) in the organization the request acts for. A demand or aggregation of any other organization, and one that does not exist, are both 404, never 403 (S-03). AUDITOR, the platform administrator (SYSTEM_ADMIN, whatever organization it selected) and a service token are refused (403) before anything is read. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` (docs/06 § 6.8): without one, or with one outside 8 to 255 characters, 400 VALIDATION_FAILED and nothing is done. The same key with the same body from the same user answers the original response and does nothing again; the same key with another body or user is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate that arrives while the first is still being processed waits for its answer and past a few seconds is 409 CONFLICT with Retry-After. The caller must be a signed-in person with a platform user id (403 otherwise).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required, 8 to 255 characters. The same key with the same body from the same user returns the first response and does nothing again; with a different body or user, 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; while the first request is still in flight, 409 CONFLICT with Retry-After. Scoped to the organization, kept for PROCUREMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS (24 by default).

403.description: Authenticated, but not permitted: a role PROCUREMENT_DEMAND_ROLES (on cancel, PROCUREMENT_RFQ_ISSUER_ROLES) does not grant in the organization the request acts for (INSUFFICIENT_ROLE), the oversight role (AUDITOR), the platform administrator (SYSTEM_ADMIN, whatever organization it selected — it never acts for a buyer), a service-to-service token, a caller acting for no organization, or — on a command — a user token without the platform user id. 409.description: On a command: an Idempotency-Key reused with a different request or user (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED) or still in flight (CONFLICT, with Retry-After); the window of the product opened or ended by another request at the same moment, more than a few times (CONFLICT, with Retry-After — retry); on withdraw and cancel, `expectedVersion` that is not the current version of the demand or aggregation (OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_FAILED — reload and retry).

Retry-After.description: Sent only when this Idempotency-Key is still being processed, or the window of the product changed meanwhile (CONFLICT): the seconds to wait before retrying with the same key. Absent on every other 409.

422.description: Well-formed but refused by the lifecycle (BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION): on submit, a demand that would take the total of the window it joins past 2147483647, the most an RFQ and a purchase order can state (AGGREGATION_QUANTITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; nothing is written); on withdraw, a demand that is not SUBMITTED (DEMAND_NOT_SUBMITTED) or whose window has ended — its aggregation is no longer OPEN, or the database clock is at or past closesAt (AGGREGATION_WINDOW_ENDED: the demand set is frozen); on cancel, an aggregation that is not READY (AGGREGATION_NOT_READY). info.title: Rasta — Procurement Service
info.description: The procurement boundary (COM-007, ADR-070). An organization registers its needs — a quantity of a product, the product an opaque marketplace identifier that is never checked there (Q-105) — and each joins the one OPEN aggregation of (organization, product), or opens it. A window is open from its first demand for PROCUREMENT_AGGREGATION_WINDOW_HOURS (Q-10), half-open [openedAt, closesAt) by the database clock read after the aggregation’s lock: a demand at or after closesAt never joins it, and ends it instead — READY when it holds a demand and reaches its threshold (a quantity, never an amount), otherwise its snapshot’s shortfall policy: EXTEND, REFER (a fact only) or CLOSE — before joining the window that follows. A window no demand arrives after is ended on time by the window sweeper, with the same transition. A READY aggregation may be cancelled with a reason by a role of the RFQ issuer. Each aggregation keeps the settings it opened with. Aggregation never spans organizations (Q-119); only the buyer’s own organization reads or changes its demands, anyone else gets 404. Every change is an event on rasta.procurement.v1 — identifiers, quantities and instants, never a note, a reason or an amount — and so an audit record. RFQs, sealed quotations, evaluation and purchase orders follow (ADR-070 plan PRs 2 to 14); nothing here moves money.
